dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Deeply concave trailing edge with a high degree of falcation transitioning from a broad base to a tapered apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Acute shape classification with a narrow pixel radius, exhibiting minimal rounding at the termination point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Steep linear incline approximately 60-70 degrees relative to the longitudinal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Vertical height-to-base ratio of approximately 1.5:1, indicating a tall, narrow profile.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple small, circular depigmented spots (macules) are visible on the lower lateral flank area; no major structural notches or traumatic scarring present on the dorsal fin edges.
other_distinctive_markers: Strongly demarcated dark triangular pigmentation patch (saddle) encompassing the dorsal fin and mid-dorsal ridge, contrasting with lighter lateral mottling.
